description: GitNoise configuration to prevent secrets from being committed

rules.name: Environment Files
rules.message: ❌ SECURITY: .env files contain secrets and must not be committed. Use .env.example instead.

rules.name: Database Credentials
rules.description: Detect database connection strings with credentials
rules.message: ❌ SECURITY: Database credentials detected. Store in environment variables, not in code.

rules.name: API Keys
rules.message: ❌ SECURITY: API key detected. Store in environment variables, not in code.

rules.name: JWT Secrets
rules.message: ❌ SECURITY: JWT secret detected. Store in environment variables, not in code.

rules.name: AWS Credentials
rules.description: Detect AWS access keys and secrets
rules.message: ❌ SECURITY: AWS credentials detected. Store in environment variables, not in code.

rules.name: Azure Keys
rules.message: ❌ SECURITY: Azure key detected. Store in environment variables, not in code.

rules.name: OpenAI Keys
rules.message: ❌ SECURITY: OpenAI key detected. Store in environment variables, not in code.

rules.name: Redis URLs
rules.description: Detect Redis connection strings with credentials
rules.message: ❌ SECURITY: Redis credentials detected. Store in environment variables, not in code.

rules.name: Private Keys
rules.message: ❌ SECURITY: Private key detected. Never commit private keys to git.

rules.name: Exposed Secrets in Documentation
rules.description: Detect actual secrets in markdown files (not examples)
rules.message: ❌ SECURITY: Real database credentials in documentation. Use placeholders like 'user:password@host'.

rules.name: Hardcoded Tokens
rules.message: ⚠️ WARNING: Possible hardcoded token. Verify this is not a secret.
